expected_deliverable: A tested canonical detached execution path and repository-local safe tmux wakeup adapter that returns the supervisor prompt immediately, queues whenever delivery is ambiguous, wakes once on eligible durable events, retains the explicit wait-cell fallback, and documents the host boundary and residual limitations.
expected_evidence: task run defaults to detached launch and returns before child completion
detached worker survives launcher exit and owns lifecycle through a durable terminal event
foreground wait-cell path requires an explicit compatibility flag

objective: Replace the canonical foreground wait-cell execution path with a detached Runner process and a durable, idempotent, generation-fenced tmux Codex wakeup adapter while preserving zero wait-induced automatic activations and the existing fallback.
operator_policy_constraints: Codex enabled with configured model and reasoning effort
model polling and wait-induced automatic reasoning prohibited
prohibited_actions: blind tmux send-keys based only on pane existence or a fixed delay
clearing, replacing, or submitting human-composed text
model polling, periodic supervisor inference, or heartbeat-triggered activation
history rewriting or direct mutation of prior durable records
release, merge, deployment, server-wide installation, or cross-repository initialization
relevant_context: The prior correction reduced a defective live interval from 23 wait-induced automatic activations to zero by keeping an enclosing tool cell open; that invariant must remain true.
The current runAttempt function awaits child and verification completion inside task run, so the supervisor cannot return to its normal prompt while work is active.

The canonical task run path must detach a repository-local Runner worker, return only after durable launch ownership is established, and leave foreground wait-cell behavior available only through an explicit fallback flag.

The Runner worker, not the supervisor turn, must own child PID, heartbeat, timeout, verification, raw evidence, Context Firewall reduction, completion handoff, terminal event, claim release, pause-after-current application, and wake queue creation.
Eligible automatic wake reasons are only child completion, failure, terminal timeout/stall, and intervention-required. Heartbeat and nonterminal progress remain ineligible.

Official Codex configuration supports a notify command receiving a JSON payload and lifecycle hooks, but there is no supported repository-level API that safely submits text into an idle TUI composer. The adapter must therefore use an explicit repo-owned readiness lease plus conservative tmux evidence; screen text alone is insufficient as canonical authority.

A safe delivery decision must bind supervisor id, exact current generation, tmux session, pane identity, Codex process identity, a fresh prompt-ready lease, no active/busy marker, no attached client or other detectable human interaction, and an empty known composer. Unsafe or ambiguous state queues durably.

Delivery must be fail-closed and idempotent. Use an atomic delivery claim/receipt; a crash-uncertain delivery must not be automatically replayed. The injected prompt must carry the event id and direct the supervisor to reconstruct durable state and consume exactly once.

A bounded short-lived detached adapter may retry safe delivery after terminal creation; no external GUI, service platform, container, distributed service, model polling, or long-running supervisor tool call is allowed.

Recovery must later drain queued eligible events exactly once. Duplicate events must not create duplicate injections. A stale supervisor generation or stale readiness lease must not consume an event targeted to the current generation.
The human must be able to use deterministic status/watch and operator controls during a detached child without transferring lifecycle ownership away from Runner.
Provider policy remains Codex enabled on gpt-5.6-sol high, Claude disabled, review off, Gearbox required, Context Firewall required, model polling forbidden.

title: Implement detached Runner and safe tmux host wakeup
